data.name: Aania
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'anā' which means 'to support'. The name Aania symbolizes the nourishment and support that a mother provides to her child. This name is a reminder of the importance of motherly love and care in the Islamic tradition.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies the spirit of nurturing and care.
